surface: Record a change /changes/new (NewChangePage.razor, CountryPicker, DecisionPill, Features/Changes, Features/Rules, docs/GOLDEN-CASES.md): scenes S2 (Maria verdict) and S5 (traps 13, 5a+5c, 15)
state_today: Ran 655ebee from a scratch copy in EN at 1152x720 and 1536x864 (1080p at 125%). The verdicts are correct and fast (0.6-1.0 s), and they match golden cases 4/13/5a/5c/15 after a reset. Problems: 'guide p. NEVERIFICAT' on Ioana; the verdict header hides under the top bar after the auto-scroll; Radu's form overflows its card; the S5 rule rows fall below the fold; the next pick clears the verdict, so 5a and 5c can't sit side by side; no deadline shown on S2; the guide text can't be reached.

items.title: Ioana (case 15) shows 'guide p. NEVERIFICAT' in English
items.evidence: Seen in the EN run: the GEN-DOMESTIC row reads '· guide p. NEVERIFICAT'. RuleCatalog.cs:69 sets GuidePage = NotVerified ('NEVERIFICAT'). CrsUi.cs:87 only special-cases blank or '?'. PITCH.md §5.2 says GEN-DOMESTIC is a design interpretation with no page.
items.proposal: In CrsUi.Page, treat RuleCatalog.NotVerified as T("not in the guide: our reading"), plus an RO key in Lang.Ro.CrsUi.cs. This also fixes the case page and DeadlineClock, which call the same helper. E2E (ChangeDecisionTests.cs:46) only checks 'does not apply', so it stays green.

items.title: After Record, the auto-scroll hides the verdict header under the top bar
items.evidence: Maria at 1152x720: scrollY 601, and 'Decision of the code' plus the glyph sit under the app bar (screenshot). The scroll anchor is a zero-height div inside a sticky column (NewChangePage.razor:201,206). revealElement uses scrollIntoView with block:start (App.razor:46). This is the S2 key frame.
items.proposal: Only reveal when the layout is one column (matchMedia max-width 959px), which is what the comment at :557 intends. Otherwise scroll to the MudPaper minus 80px. Keep it inside the reduced-motion check.

items.title: Radu's standing-order form overflows its card; client names are truncated
items.evidence: 5a/5c at 1152 and 1536 wide: the Client field shows 'Ra...', and the 'From account' select runs under the verdict column. The labels 'Beneficiary ...' and the depository hint are clipped. app.css:487 uses '1fr 1fr' with no minmax. Class="span-2" never reaches the grid item (NewChangePage.razor:60,102): Maria shows as 'Maria Popescu · ...'.
items.proposal: Change app.css:487 to minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr). Wrap the Client autocomplete and the From account select in <div class="span-2">. Recheck at 1152, 1536 and 390. While Radu's name is unreadable, the voice line 'Radu has a standing order' has nothing on screen to match.

items.title: S5 evidence (reason, rule ID, guide page) is below the fold at the filming size
items.evidence: 1536x864: the verdict starts at y≈484. For case 13 only the cleared rule title is visible; its reason, CRS-IND-PHONE and 'guide p. 29' are below 864. The golden card is about 275px and the header about 160px (NewChangePage.razor:17,30-53). The Record button sits at y 752-863. Each trap needs a scroll, which does not fit 4 changes in about 21 s.
items.proposal: After a pick, collapse the golden card into a one-line bar (chips plus 'Change'). Lift the decisive rule into the verdict head: the first uncovered hit, or else the first cleared rule (title, reason, ID, page). Keep the full list below.

items.title: Picking the next case clears the verdict: no 5a next to 5c
items.evidence: SelectClientAsync sets _result = null (NewChangePage.razor:428), and UseAsync calls it (:450). Every pick wipes the previous verdict. PITCH.md S5 asks for case 5c 'right next to' 5a, and the voice says 'the same order to the US is a FATCA alert'. Today the two never share a frame.
items.proposal: Keep a per-circuit list of the ChangeResults recorded this session and render them as compact cards (see the idea 'Trap board'). Give the cards a class other than .crs-verdict: the E2E tests locate .crs-verdict and would hit a strict-mode error on several matches.

items.title: Recording 5a after 5c on the same database gives 'FATCA alert, differs from golden case 5a'
items.evidence: Seen in the scratch run: a second 5a on Radu after 5c gave 'FATCA alert · Differs from golden case 5a, which expects No case'. The engine evaluates the whole client after the change (CrsRuleEngine.cs:21-22). The history seed never touches CL-0001/0005/0013/0015 (ChangeHistorySeed.cs:38), so any earlier change there comes from a rehearsal.
items.proposal: On each golden chip, run Changes.ListAsync(code, 1). If anything is there, show 'recorded since the reset: the result may differ'. Add 'Reset demo data' to the Demo menu (DemoData.ResetAsync, admin, ConfirmAsync, keys already in Lang.Ro.cs:270). Demo lead: reset right before every take and before the jury demo.

items.title: S2: the verdict shows no deadline although the voice says the 90 days start
items.evidence: The verdict actions (NewChangePage.razor:228-233) offer only 'Open case X'. The engine text even says 'The case workflow computes the deadline, not the engine'. PITCH.md S2: 'New account: the 90-day deadline starts on its own'. Today the deadline only appears on /cases/{code}.
items.proposal: After RecordAsync, if CaseCode is set, call Cases.GetAsync(code) and show 'Deadline 27 Jan 2027 · N days · DL-NEW-90 · guide p. 20-21, 35-36 · reminder 22 Jan'. For FATCA (DueAt null): 'The agreement sets no deadline'. Use the real DeadlineRuleId; never hard-code 90 (never-say list).
items.data_source: ICaseService.GetAsync -> Case.DueAt, RemindAt, DeadlineRuleId, DeadlineGuidePage, IsPreexisting; CrsUi.DaysBetween(Clock.UtcNow, DueAt)

items.title: Verdict lead text is engine jargon; 'Clarification' alone doesn't say 'case opened'
items.evidence: NewChangePage.razor:215 shows o.Explanation as the main paragraph, e.g. 'CRS clarification: CRS-IND-ADDR (DE), CRS-IND-PHONE (DE) are not covered by the current self-certification... (IV.C(1)). The case workflow computes the deadline, not the engine.' A plain line already exists (CrsUi.Describe, translated in Lang.Ro.CrsUi.cs:102) but appears only as a DecisionPill tooltip.
items.proposal: Under the title, show CrsUi.Describe(o.Decision) at body size, e.g. 'At least one CRS indicium is uncovered: a case is open and the deadline runs.' Put the engine text below in crs-hint, labelled 'Engine's explanation'. No new keys except that label.

items.title: Cleared rows hide the country: 5c shows two identical standing-order rows
items.evidence: Seen in the EN run of 5c: two rows both titled 'Standing order to a reportable jurisdiction' (one DE, one US) with no country. Hit rows show the country (NewChangePage.razor:245); cleared rows don't (:257).
items.proposal: On cleared rows, add '· @CrsUi.Country(hit.Jurisdiction)' when Jurisdiction is not empty. GEN-DOMESTIC then reads 'Change within Romania · Romania (RO)'.

items.title: The 'checked, does not apply' row looks inert, though it is the trap's whole point
items.evidence: Cleared rows get a grey minus icon (NewChangePage.razor:255; app.css:524 text-disabled colour) and an untoned 'does not apply' pill (:261). PITCH.md S5 is built on 'checked, does not apply' with the reason. On video the row reads as disabled.
items.proposal: Use a neutral check icon (Rounded.Rule or Check) that ticks in. Change the pill to T("Checked · does not apply"), which keeps the substring ChangeDecisionTests.cs:46 asserts. Show the reason at body size, not crs-hint, for NoCase verdicts.

items.title: The 'Our reading' basis is missing on /changes/new (Maria's and 5c's hits rest on interpretation)
items.evidence: RuleHit.Basis is Interpretation for new accounts (Findings.cs:49; Maria 2019, Radu 2017) and for GEN-DOMESTIC. RuleModels.cs:35 says 'the UI shows it'. The case page does (CaseDetailPage.razor:100); the verdict meta line (NewChangePage.razor:247,259) does not.
items.proposal: When Basis != Verified, add <Pill>@CrsUi.Label(hit.Basis)</Pill> ('Our reading' / 'Bank policy', already translated) to both meta lines. Being honest about the interpretation matches the motto and SUBMISSION.md.

items.title: The rule meta line wraps with a dangling '· guide p. 29' on its own line
items.evidence: In the 354-480px verdict column every row renders 'CRS-IND-PHONE' and then '· guide p. 29 · Uncovered' on the next line (screenshots). Cause: .crs-quote-meta is display:flex (app.css:387) and the separators sit in a bare text node (NewChangePage.razor:247,259).
items.proposal: Render each part as its own <span> with CSS separators (.crs-quote-meta > span + span::before { content:'·' }), or set white-space:nowrap per part, so the ID, page and status wrap as whole units.

items.title: 'US (US)' in English, and bare codes in the country picker
items.evidence: The 5c run shows 'Standing order to a US account · US (US)', and the Country field shows 'US (US)'. CrsUi.Country strips 'the ' from 'the US (US)' (CrsUi.cs:46-51; Jurisdictions.cs:70). Codes without a name (PL, CY, ...) show as bare codes in CountryPicker (CountryPicker.razor:21).
items.proposal: In CrsUi.Country, special-case US to 'United States (US)' in EN. For unnamed codes fall back to new RegionInfo(code).EnglishName / NativeName, which stays in Components with no backend change.

items.title: BACKEND GAP: the EN reason repeats 'from a depository account (depository account)'
items.evidence: Seen on screen for 5a and 5c: 'Standing order to Germany (DE) from a depository account (depository account): excepted under CRS...'. CrsIndicia.cs:175 uses ProductEn(account), which returns the account type, not the product. The RO text uses ProductNote (the product name) and reads correctly.
items.proposal: Smallest change, in Features/Rules/CrsIndicia.cs:175: use ProductNote(account), i.e. the product name '(Cont curent EUR)', or drop the parenthetical in EN. First grep the tests for that EN string (R1 owns the rule texts). This sentence is the S5 5a frame.

items.title: The guide text can't be reached from the app
items.evidence: docs/ghid/pagini/p-0NN.md and the 856 KB ANAF PDF sit outside src. The Dockerfile copies only src/. No route serves them and nothing links to them (grep of Components and Program.cs). 'guide p. 29' is plain text. I checked that PDF page 29 = printed page 29 (pdftotext).
items.proposal: Copy the PDF to wwwroot/guide/ghid-anaf-2025-12-29.pdf (MapStaticAssets serves it). In CrsUi, make the page a link to #page={first number}, target _blank, with the tooltip 'ANAF guide, 29.12.2025'. Used on the verdict, the case page and DeadlineClock.

items.title: Golden groups don't follow the S5 sequence (13, 5a, 5c, 15)
items.evidence: Picks (NewChangePage.razor:323-330): 'Traps: no case' is ordered 15, 1, 5a, 13, 8, and 5c sits under 'FATCA'. S5 needs two segment switches and a scan through 5 chips, within 21 s.
items.proposal: Add a group T("The three traps") holding 13, 5a, 5c, 15 in pitch order, placed second. Keep 'Opens a case' first: GoldenPickerTests clicks chip 12 in the default group. A duplicate Id across groups is fine, since ?scenario picks the first one. RO key goes in Lang.Ro.CrsUi.cs.

items.title: Chips don't name Radu or Ioana, and the form truncates names
items.evidence: Chip text is '@s.Id @T(s.Title)' (NewChangePage.razor:47): '5a Standing order to Germany from a current account', '15 Cluj to Iasi'. The voice names Radu and Ioana, and the Client field shows 'Ra...'.
items.proposal: Add <small>@ClientName(s.Golden.ClientCode)</small> to each chip, from _clients (FullName); the CSS .crs-chip small already exists (app.css:552). The chip HasText 'In-care-of address in Italy' (E2E) still matches.

items.title: 'Matches golden case N' compares only the decision, not the rules
items.evidence: NewChangePage.razor:219 sets match = o.Decision == g.Expected. If the decision matched but different rules fired, it would still say 'Matches'. The golden card fixes ExpectedHits exactly and ExpectedCleared as a subset (GOLDEN-CASES.md:22-23).

items.title: Long rule explanations make the verdict about 1,700px tall in a narrow column
items.evidence: 5c verdict box is 1725px tall at 1152 wide (column 354px; crs-grid.two is 1.3fr/1fr, app.css:369). Each of Maria's hits runs 8-10 lines, adding the GEN-NEW-ACCOUNT note and 'already there before this change'.
items.proposal: Once a result exists, add .has-result to flip the grid to 1fr/1.3fr. Clamp each explanation to 2 lines (-webkit-line-clamp) with a 'More' toggle, so the rule ID and page stay visible.

items.evidence: NewChangePage.razor:546 sets _submitError = ex.Message, and :396 sets _error = ex.Message. The handoff rule is to use CrsUi.Problem(ex) (friendly prefix plus the service reason). A validation error in the live demo would show bare service English.

items.title: Trap board: recorded verdicts stay side by side
items.evidence: S5 wants four verdicts in about 21 s and 5a next to 5c (PITCH.md S5). Today each pick wipes the last verdict (NewChangePage.razor:428).

Each shows the client, the change kind, a DecisionPill, the decisive rule (title, reason, ID, guide page) and the golden match. 5a and 5c sit side by side, and the last S5 frame shows all four. Use the class .crs-board-card, not .crs-verdict.

items.title: Guide excerpt popover: the law line behind each rule
items.evidence: Motto: code decides, and each rule cites the guide. p-029.md holds lit. a-f verbatim, e.g. c) 'unul sau mai multe numere de telefon ... și niciun număr de telefon în România'. The UI shows only 'guide p. 29'.
items.proposal: Click 'guide p. 29 · lit. c' to open a popover with the original Romanian line (labelled 'Original text, ANAF guide 29.12.2025') and the rule's English Description as the gloss, plus 'Open the guide at p. 29'. This is the 2-second proof frame for the traps.
items.data_source: RuleCatalog.Get(id).Description/LegalBasis; text copied from docs/ghid/pagini/p-029.md, p-031.md, p-035.md

items.title: Show the guide letter: 'guide p. 29, lit. c', as the pitch says
items.evidence: PITCH.md S2/S5 cite 'p. 29 lit. b/c/d' and 'p. 31'. The UI shows 'guide p. 29' and 'guide p. 29, 17-18' for CRS-IND-SO. The letter is already in LegalBasis ('CPF Anexa 1, Sec. III.B pct. 12 lit. c); pct. 13').
items.proposal: In CrsUi, add PageAndLetter(ruleId, page). It takes the first 'lit. x)' from LegalBasis (regex), and shows 'guide p. 29, lit. c' for CRS/FATCA indicium rules; other rules keep the page alone.

items.title: Deadline ruler inside the S2 verdict
items.evidence: The ruler is the product's signature piece (handoff §2), but on S2 it only appears after a click to the case page. The S2 voice ends on the deadline starting.
items.proposal: Under the verdict, reuse <DeadlineClock Case="_case" Now="Clock.UtcNow" /> (as in CaseDetailPage.razor:69), maybe in a compact variant, so the 90 days visibly start on /changes/new. Builds on the deadline gap.

items.title: Compare 5a and 5c on the engine without saving: one field differs
items.evidence: 5a and 5c are the same order from the same current account; only the beneficiary country differs (GOLDEN-CASES.md:98-103). The engine is pure: Evaluate(before, after, kind) (RuleModels.cs:79).
items.proposal: Add a 'Compare 5a / 5c' toggle. It runs ICrsRuleEngine.Evaluate(g.Before!, g.After!, g.Change!.Kind) for both, side by side, highlighting 'Germany → US' and 'No case → FATCA alert'. Label it 'Same engine, golden snapshots, nothing saved'. It doesn't depend on the database state.

items.title: Closed list strip: p. 29 lit. a-f and p. 31 lit. a-g with the hit lit
items.evidence: The engine runs every detector on the whole snapshot (CrsRuleEngine.cs:100-106), and the catalog has 7 CRS-IND and 7 FATCA-IND rules (RuleCatalog.cs:89-174). The 'closed list' wording is in the engine text, but the list is never shown.
items.proposal: Under the verdict, show a row of letter tokens a-f (CRS) and a-g (FATCA) named by CrsUi.ShortRule. Tones: warning = applies, neutral tick = checked with a reason, faint = nothing on file. Tooltip: the rule title and ID. Makes 'closed list' instantly visual.

items.title: /rules catalog page with guide links
items.evidence: S9 claims every indicium has its rule and guide page (PITCH.md:191). No page lists the catalog (grep: RuleCatalog is used only in CrsUi and Metrics). The jury reviews the code and the live app.
items.proposal: New page Pages/Rules/RulesPage.razor: rule ID, regime, EN title, description, guide page (PDF link), legal basis, basis pill. Rule IDs on the verdict link to /rules#ID. Add a nav item in SiteConfig under CRS.

items.title: Audit receipt under the verdict, even for No case
items.evidence: ChangeService writes change.received plus one rule.applied entry per hit or cleared rule (ChangeService.cs:139-150), even for NoCase. The verdict doesn't say so; S7 then has to prove the chain separately.
items.proposal: Add the row 'Logged in the audit chain: #412-#414 · hash 3f9a…', linking to /audit. Find the entries with IAuditLog.ListAsync(take: 20), keeping those whose PayloadJson changeId == res.Change.Id. This bridges S5 to S7.

items.title: 'Who decided' line on every verdict
items.evidence: Motto: code decides, AI explains, the human approves. The verdict says only 'Decision of the code' (NewChangePage.razor:211).
items.proposal: Add one line: for NoCase/Compliant, 'Code decided · no AI · nothing for a person to approve'. For a case: 'Code decided · next: the agent drafts the request, a person approves sending'. Picked by Decision and CaseCode; no model output.

items.title: 'Next trap' button in the verdict
items.evidence: Each S5 trap needs a scroll back up, a segment switch and a chip (NewChangePage.razor:38-50). Measured: under 1 s to the verdict, but about 5 s of interaction per trap.
items.proposal: While a golden scenario is active, show a 'Next: 5a Radu' button in the verdict that calls UseAsync on the next scenario of the trap group and focuses Record. The Record button keeps its frozen label.

items.title: 'Record the three traps' Demo action
items.evidence: 21 s for four changes leaves no room for a misclick. DemoContext.Offer is the sanctioned place for shortcuts (NewChangePage.razor:400-404).
items.proposal: A Demo menu item that records 13, 5a, 5c, 15 in turn via Changes.RecordAsync(golden.Change), 1.5 s apart, filling the Trap board. A snackbar says 'Demo: four golden changes recorded; every decision is the code's'. Use it only if the manual clicks fail in rehearsal.

items.title: Session counter: 'Every change evaluated; only the relevant ones start a deadline'
items.evidence: S1 and the never-say list stress that every update is evaluated and only tax-relevant ones start a deadline (SUBMISSION.md:73). The page never shows that ratio.
items.proposal: Above the Trap board: 'This session: 5 changes evaluated · 2 cases · 3 no case', with zero deadlines for no-case changes. Counted from the session's ChangeResults; no new data.

items.title: No-code filming fallback: one tab per trap via ?scenario=
items.evidence: LoadAsync already fills the form from ?scenario=ID (NewChangePage.razor:385-392). Ctrl+Tab between pre-filled tabs takes no scroll and no picker clicks.
items.proposal: Demo lead: after a reset, open /changes/new?scenario=13, 5a, 5c, 15 in four tabs. In each, click 'Record and apply the rules' and cut between them. Works today if the frontend fixes slip past 08:00.
